prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop website direction comp
Primary request: Create a 16:10 full-fidelity first viewport for Avancini OS in the “Atlas Vivo” visual world, with a more premium project-led composition than the initial concept.
Scene/backdrop: warm off-white mineral paper, very subtle grain, sparse cobalt cartographic lines.
Subject: a compact precision header with AVANCINI OS left, ESTÚDIO / PROJETOS / SERVIÇOS / CONTATO centered, MENU right. The left third has the monumental headline exactly “Ideias que encontram direção. Tecnologia que faz avançar.” The right two thirds are dominated by one huge editorial project image window labeled “PROJETO REAL — TAPE CAR”. A thin route line crosses from the headline through four small nodes: IDENTIDADE, EXPERIÊNCIA, AUTOMAÇÃO, SISTEMAS. One small lime action block says “COMEÇAR UM PROJETO”.
Style/medium: award-level Brazilian digital design studio, premium editorial atlas, high-contrast serif with disciplined modern grotesk, tactile print registration details.
Composition/framing: bold asymmetric editorial spread, one focal image, no repeated cards, no decorative clutter, large confident spacing, glimpse of next content at bottom.
Color palette: #eeeae0 paper, #151515 ink, #3157ff cobalt, one #e8ff3d lime action.
Text (verbatim): “AVANCINI OS”; “ESTÚDIO”; “PROJETOS”; “SERVIÇOS”; “CONTATO”; “MENU”; “Ideias que encontram direção. Tecnologia que faz avançar.”; “PROJETO REAL — TAPE CAR”; “IDENTIDADE”; “EXPERIÊNCIA”; “AUTOMAÇÃO”; “SISTEMAS”; “COMEÇAR UM PROJETO”.
Constraints: exact legible Portuguese, no fake statistics, no testimonials, no fictional client logos, no generic SaaS cards, no green neon, no dashboard, premium and commercially clear.
